description: history.vocabulary serves the closed sets as data (HV2): the lanes are internal/history's four GroupBy constants, the outcome words are the statuses the loop engine writes, the filter keys are the params the reads take — a client renders words it is served and types none. The sets are derived from package constants at call time (TestVocabularyEqualsTheConstants moves a constant and the answer moves with it), and a stored status outside the set renders verbatim on a row rather than collapsing into a known word.
